implementation_basis: Independent public HTTP responses; existing MacCMS adapter. Plugin source was used only for scope/risk investigation (C4, ADR-048).

aes.basis: C4 / ADR-048 static investigation of commit 25cdd2119be03f62ae6a5a2cf46b16f9484224a2
aes.finding: aesDecrypt is defined in Utils.kt without callers; ordinary JSON requires no additional plugin AES decryption. encrypt=1/2 is escaping/Base64; Haiwaikan/JiangNan registration is commented out.

runtime.configuration: Existing manual HTTP source manager (T0.17); preset UI belongs to T0.22.
runtime.exclusion_basis: src-tauri/tauri.conf.json has an empty bundle.resources; Cargo has no Android/DEX runtime dependency. Packaged artifact exclusion still requires A1.

network.reason: Original run.py exited 125 at macOS sysctl process enumeration under workspace-write; cleanup_failed receipt must be recovered by the outer agent per ADR-010.
network.privacy: Public API endpoints only; signed media URLs, headers, capabilities and raw response bodies remain in native memory. Capture output replaces every media/image URL and omits unknown fields.
